brand.name: Iron & Ember Athletic Club
brand.tagline: Train hard. Recover well. Strength coaching, group classes and open gym in the heart of Fortitude Valley.
brand.description: Iron & Ember Athletic Club is a fictional gym used as a concept demo: strength coaching, group classes, open gym, recovery and a spinning 3D barbell.
brand.demoFooter: Concept demo by KB Ventures. Not a real business.

coaches.name: Marcus Quinn
coaches.bio: Marcus opened Iron & Ember in 2012 after a decade coaching in other people’s gyms. He runs the strength programs and still coaches the 5:30am crowd.

coaches.name: Jonah Reyes
coaches.bio: A former amateur boxer who turned his footwork into a coaching career. Jonah runs the HIIT and boxing classes with a loud playlist and a quiet eye for technique.

coaches.name: Dev Nair
coaches.bio: Dev teaches yoga and mobility for people who lift, run and sit at desks. Expect clear cues, honest modifications and a very long exhale.

coaches.name: Dex Holloway
coaches.bio: Dex coaches the heavy lifts and the engine-room conditioning. He loves a good deadlift, a better warm-up and explaining why your knees do that.

pages.title: Home
pages.description: Strength coaching, group classes and open gym in Fortitude Valley, Brisbane. A concept demo for a fictional gym with a slowly rotating 3D barbell.

pages.title: Class timetable
pages.description: Thirty-two classes a week: strength, HIIT, yoga, mobility and boxing. Pick a day, filter by type and book a spot.
pages.lead: Strength, HIIT, yoga, mobility and boxing from 5:30am. Pick a day, filter by type, then book a spot.

pages.title: Coaches
pages.description: Meet the four coaches at Iron & Ember Athletic Club and book a session with the one that fits your goals.
pages.lead: Four coaches, one rule: every rep has a reason. Pick the one who suits your goals and book a session.

pages.title: Free trial & class booking
pages.description: Start your 7-day free trial or book a class. Choose a coach, a date and a time. Demo booking with live time slots.
pages.lead: Book your first coached session to start your 7-day free trial, or reserve a spot in any class. Pick a coach, a day and a time.
